brief_author_note: The program gives each arm a distinct timed turn with tool_beta and releases the tool after both uses.
program_source:
def task():
    acquire("left", "tool_beta")
    wait("left", 80000000)
    release("left", "tool_beta")
    acquire("right", "tool_beta")
    wait("right", 80000000)
    release("right", "tool_beta")
